MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive-lined heat shrink tubing feels like a useful next purchase because it could insulate and seal connections made with my spade terminals.",
    "The solder-seal connectors fit my interest in practical wire repairs, offering permanent sealed connections alongside the quick-disconnect terminals I already bought."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Separate casters, specific-size washers and polishing wheels require projects or compatible equipment I have not shown a need for; being repair supplies alone does not make them useful to me now.",
    "My earlier portion cups and adhesives do not mean I need larger cups or ten tubes of super glue. Quantity, size and the particular repair matter to my choice.",
    "The gloves and gallon of floor cleaner do not connect to an immediate task suggested by my purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical maintenance supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop item.",
    "Past purchases seem to be treated as reasons to buy similar supplies again, even when the purpose, size or amount is different."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about whether an item complements supplies I already have and solves a specific repair problem, such as sealing electrical connections.",
    "Related products can be alternatives: I would choose the adhesive-lined tubing now without also buying the other tubing assortment.",
    "I buy selectively, so an old purchase does not establish a current replenishment need or justify a large pack."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical repair interests, but often mistake broad similarity for a concrete need in my current projects."
}
